TeleTV %1$s

An unofficial Telegram client for TVs: browse your chats and watch their videos with the remote control.

Source code and new versions: github.com/%2$s

This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Telegram. It uses the public Telegram API and connects only to Telegram servers and, to look for updates, to GitHub. It does not collect or send usage data.


SUPPORT

TeleTV is free and has no ads. Bitcoin donations: %3$s
